name: resolve_todo
reason: The clauses only pin the @inline and @noinline call-site cases, a MAX_INLINE_COST source and "a constant result is not inlined", so a function that inlines only at @inline call sites, or returns compileable instead of ConstantCase, passes; the ordinary decision (no annotation, finite cost -> inline) and the constant and no-result branches are never stated, and the edge bookkeeping and returned IR are not modelled.

name: semiconcrete_result_item
reason: The clauses only pin the call-site @noinline, call-site @inline and declared-@noinline cases, so a function that inlines only at @inline call sites passes; the ordinary case (inlining on, no annotations -> inline when the policy accepts the IRCode) is never stated.

name: handle_cases!
reason: Only the single-case branch is an iff; the union-split and flags branches are stated as necessary conditions on their result, so a function that returns nothing for every multi-case or zero-case call passes; the push of the UnionSplit and the add_flag! are never required.

name: inline_const_if_inlineable!
reason: The replaced/kept result is pinned, but in the kept case the new flag is only required to contain the old flag and IR_FLAGS_REMOVABLE, so a function that also sets IR_FLAG_INBOUNDS or IR_FLAG_NOINLINE passes; flag | IR_FLAGS_REMOVABLE exactly is never stated.

name: linear_inline_eligible
reason: Mirror of the three early returns; proven for every block count and terminator that it is true exactly for one block ending in a ReturnNode with a value.

name: early_inline_special_case
reason: The constant replacement is an iff, but the compilerbarrier, ifelse and task_result_type rewrites are only stated as necessary conditions (result = arg3 -> ...), so a function that never performs them passes, although the registry statement says "exactly".
